previous_assumption: A Path C (auction-sourced) CommercialQuotation could be exempted from requiring renterAcceptedAt before awardQuotation, on the reasoning that the Renter's earlier auction selectParticipant call was already consent to whatever commercial terms the Rental Company set afterward.
correction: User flagged live: this was actually a third instance of the same self-award pattern already fixed twice before (auction winner-selection, then commercial-quotation acceptance) — auction participant selection only decides WHO gets to quote, not agreement to the rate/dates/charges that participant sets afterward in the CommercialQuotation. The Rental Company could send Path C terms and award them unilaterally, and the Renter never saw an Accept/counter-offer option at all (needsRenterAcceptance short-circuited on sourceAuctionId, so canAccept was always false for Path C). Reverted: removed the sourceAuctionId exemption from awardQuotation's guard (backend) and from needsRenterAcceptance/acceptanceLabel/the acceptance badge/the awaitingAcceptanceCount KPI filter (frontend) — Path C is now held to exactly the same acceptance-before-award rule as Path A/B, restoring the Renter's Accept/counter-offer/Decline panel for auction-sourced quotations too. Also documented (not fixed, separate scope) a related but distinct finding: the Rental Company itself has no UI to send a NEW counter-offer in response to the Renter's counter, only to accept it — makeOffer already supports either party on the backend, it's a frontend-only gap (docs/backend-hardening-report.md).
